entry.title: Edit memory settings for existing projects
entry.content: You can now change a project’s memory setting after you create it. Open the project, select the three-dot menu, choose Project settings, and select Default memory or Project-only memory under Memory. With project-only memory, ChatGPT can use conversations from the same project for context, but it won’t reference memories or conversations from outside the project. Information from the project is also kept out of memory used in chats outside the project.Changes may take a few hours to take effect.

entry.title: Chat model defaults

The ChatGPT Desktop app should be upgraded to version 26.812.10818 or later for the new controls to take effect.
